base.story: EPS near the top of management's framework (2027 ~$12.9, 2028 ~$14.5), Crane restarts in 2027, December 2026 BRA clears at the ~$325 collar cap, one more nuclear PPA signed; unlock absorbed with buyback support; ~19x NTM ~$14.2.

bull.story: GW-scale hyperscaler deal at a nuclear or Calpine site, EPS tracks or beats consensus ($13.3+ in 2027), rates roll over; multiple re-expands to ~24x NTM ~$15.3.

thesis_break_reason: $197 is ~14x my 2028E of $14.5 (and ~14x the framework's ~$14.2) and ~14% under the 2026 low of $228.63. Trading there would most likely mean the earnings path is breaking: a February 2027 guide well below the framework, failure to contract the open nuclear position at premium prices, adverse PJM/FERC co-location or capacity rules, a Crane slip, or Calpine-leverage/credit trouble. The June 2027 unlock and a 10y above 5% can plausibly push the stock to $210-220 without breaking the thesis.

reasoning: Round 2. Anchor: $264.58 spot, 47% realized vol, -20% YoY. The supervisor's primary-filing checks moved three of my inputs, and I verified the key one myself in the Q2 deck [16]: management guides BASE EPS (~$6.70 2026 -> $7.65 2027 -> $11.65 2029) with enhanced at 35-40%/30-35% of total, so the framework implies 2027 total ~$12.2 and 2028 ~$14.2, below the $13.34 consensus I grew 15% to $15.3 in round 1. I only partly concede: the 2026 guide already runs $0.50 above the March framework, so I use 2027E $12.9 / 2028E $14.5 rather than $14.2, and horizon NTM EPS ~$14.1 x 19x = $268. The FCF leg moves from a 6.0% to a 6.5% yield (125bp over the 5.24% 10y), giving $266. Blended fair value falls from $284 to ~$268, ~1% above spot. I drop the 67% Polymarket hike figure as a driver (noisy one-day snapshot) but keep the rate view it supported, which FRED confirms. The PJM 2029/30 BRA moves to December 2026. New in-lane item: the Sep 10 RISEC purchase ($715M, ~$580M net, accretive, buyback kept) [21] is modestly positive but small. Scenarios $185/$272/$370 at 25/50/25 give a mean of ~$275 and a median near $268-270. Ladder: lognormal-like, median ~$268, sigma ~40% (below the overhang-inflated 47% realized, above a typical large-cap), with slightly fattened tails; P(>=265) 0.516 vs 0.545 in round 1.
